paper.central_claim: 跨任务积累并复用经验(可验证技能库+解决方案/细化/执行三类记忆)，使药物性质预测 agent 在单任务排名第一，并在 16 个小任务建立记忆后于 17 个留出任务上零测试时搜索即比 20 次搜索的基线高 10–30%。
paper.title: DrugSAGE:Self-evolving Agent Experience for Efficient State-of-the-Art Drug Discovery

rs_pattern.reason: Opus: adapt_via_conditioning (both seats name it), sub null. The frozen Claude agent adapts to a new task by conditioning on retrieved cross-task experience, and DrugSAGE-zero routes a verified recipe by task signature with no search. C03 is not assigned (r17b convention): there is no upstream phase that teaches a model to parse a unified schema, and the routing is a metadata lookup of a recipe that is then retrained on the target. sol's primary heterogeneous_decomposition is not kept: the R/H/Q split is a storage schema that the paper never contrasts with a uniform store of the same content, so the card's tactic (showing that uniform treatment is suboptimal) is not executed.

matches.tactic_steps_checked: 1 规范条件化模式：任务签名+记忆检索(非统一格式训练)；2 参考底座：16 个任务的方案库；3 无上游训练：直接对齐/检索(互补子动作)；4 留出整类别：Polaris 11 任务为新类别，TDC 6 任务有同类类比，做了去同类消融；5 对手基线：最近邻/排行榜模型基线缺位
matches.success_failure_checks: 失败模式“声称 zero-shot 而基线未获同样信息”：基线既无记忆也无文献技能库，且 TDC 部分用于建记忆——命中；成功条件“结构化留出+条件化信号开关消融”：Polaris 留出+图4b 部分满足
matches.reason: Opus final: conditioning a frozen agent on retrieved cross-task experience; recipe routing at B=0. C03's upstream-parsing tactic is absent, so sub null.

assessment.evidence_level_note: Opus (both seats): memory is built on 16 source tasks and read on 17 held-out targets (11 Polaris tasks never enter Z). The store-off comparison on the held-out TDC targets (Figure 4b) is stated in text as monotone (opus:O05). Its values are figure-only, which limits E.causality, not the level.

G.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Search is repeated from scratch on every task. Baselines with only within-task memory are compared, and Agentomics is named as the closest neighbour. Not 4: no other cross-task-memory ML agent is compared, and the neighbours are checked only as this paper describes them.

M.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Each memory type feeds one search interface (family prior via UCB, parent sampler, edit grounding, verified repair), and B=0 routing is specified. Not 4: transferability is assumed from metric/type/size/description similarity, and the regret theorem is a weak, order-only guarantee.

X.reason: Opus sides with son55. Read-side interfaces and the skill library's tiered validation are clear. The cross-task memory, however, writes back every executed candidate with no admission gate, deduplication, expiry, conflict handling or rollback (son55:E006). The algorithm's own constants (α, β, λ in Eqs. 1/3; γ, δ in Appendix I) and the order in which the 16 source tasks populate Z are not stated (full text searched). Main steps are described; retention conditions are not (anchor 2).

E.measurement.reason: Shared correction (both seats 3). The official TDC 5-seed splits and native metrics are trustworthy, and the per-task absolute tables exist. But the paper's numbers contradict each other on claims it relies on. The §4.3 analog ablation quotes leaderboard values 0.820/0.898/0.728 against the 0.859/0.916/0.790 in Tables 2 and 6 (opus:O01, opus:O02, opus:O04). The abstract's '33 tasks, single-task, nine agents' does not match the 22 TDC tasks and eight baselines (son55:E019, son55:E020). Headline gains are on a min-max scale, and Biomni is not reproduced. Run convention caps text–table contradictions at 2.

E.causality.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. DrugSAGE-anchor isolates the skill library, the memory-off/Q/full ablation exists (direction only, opus:O05), and same-category sources are removed on 3 targets. Missing: a B=0 'skill library, no memory' or fixed-best-recipe arm, and baselines with K. The comparators lack both K and Z, so the 10–30% cannot be attributed to memory.

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. There are 16 source tasks and 17 targets, the 11 Polaris tasks never enter Z, selection is on validation, and test is reported. Not 4: no molecule-overlap or pretraining audit (the transferred recipes are leaderboard model ensembles), and the 6 TDC targets share the benchmark.

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 2 (A2 tier 2): per-task mean ± std over 5 seeds, plus negative cases (LD50). No repeats of the agent search or memory construction, no interval on the 17-task averages, no significance tests.

E.cost.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. A test-time API cost comparison exists (Figure 4a; the text states the ordering and near-zero zero-search cost), along with the L40S/24 h cap and the B mapping. Construction cost of Z and K and the cost of failed candidates are not amortised.
